page.content:
Odin's wife, who almost made Baldur invulnerable.

How Frigg connects

  • Faction: Aesir — Frigg is Odin's wife among the Aesir.
  • Event: Death of Baldur — Frigg's missed oath on mistletoe makes Baldur's death possible.

What is Frigg?

Frigg sits in Fensalir and knows many fates she does not speak. Her failed warding of Baldur is the turning of the late mythic age.

Key threads lead to Aesir and Death of Baldur.
